Global Production & Supply Footprint.assessed_on: We verified that the company maintains an extensive domestic petrochemical production footprint in India with a widespread global polymer export reach. Based on primary research, the company's dedicated medical film production capacities can be estimated as integrated within world scale multipurpose lines, based on its total annual polymer production capacity of over 5.8 million metric tonnes across multiple plants.

estimates.estimated_value: integrated within world scale multipurpose lines
estimates.basis: its total annual polymer production capacity of over 5.8 million metric tonnes across multiple plants

evidence.claim: The company has actively advanced its polypropylene production capabilities by developing proprietary catalyst lines, transitioning from its third-generation morphological RELCAT100Y/RELD technology to current commercialization efforts for fourth-generation shape- and size-controlled RELCAT200Y/RELD and RELCAT300Y/RELD technologies, as detailed on the Reliance Industries Research & Development Portal.

The company successfully developed and commercialised a chemical recycling process that converts plastic waste-based pyrolysis oil into ISCC-Plus certified circular polypropylene polymers under the brand name CircuRepol, shipping its initial batch in December 2023 as documented by a Reliance Industries Press Release.

R&D Investment & Innovation Pipeline.assessed_on: We verified that the company's documented polymer innovation rests primarily on broad-use polypropylene catalyst development and circular economy recycling initiatives. Based on primary research, the company's dedicated medical material R&D expenditure and pipeline can be estimated as robust with active customized grade innovation, based on its over 1,156 patents granted and large 300,000 square foot research division.

estimates.estimated_value: robust with active customized grade innovation
estimates.basis: its over 1,156 patents granted and large 300,000 square foot research division
estimates.source: Reliance Industries Limited Research and Development Overview

evidence.claim: Reliance Industries Limited manufactures medical-grade polypropylene raw materials under its dedicated RELPURE polymer brand to meet global regulatory compliance standards for healthcare packaging and medical components.

Market Share & Brand Leadership.assessed_on: Our evaluation rests on the company's self-reported development of compliant healthcare polyolefins, but independent, third-party verified metrics regarding its specific standing or volume sales in the medical films supply chain are absent. Based on primary research, the company's global medical film polymer market share and brand leadership can be estimated as dominant domestically while expanding as an emerging international participant, based on its position as the largest polymer producer in India and an active global polyolefin supplier.

estimates.estimated_value: dominant domestically while expanding as an emerging international participant
estimates.basis: its position as the largest polymer producer in India and an active global polyolefin supplier
estimates.source: Reliance Polymers and Reliance Industries Limited Reports
